text: yes dude nice ok now last thing, do you have the blade height and density and color control inside of the game settings that can be changed in the globals here and if not, can u set it up
resolution: Finished the grass globals/settings. All grass values are now a mutable GRASS_CONFIG (blade height min/max, density per paint level sparse/med/lush, root colour range rootLo/rootHi as r/g/b) registered as P2 tunables (system 'grass') → they appear on /settings, persist via the tuning snapshot, and clamp/write-through like any knob. The editor re-bakes the field live: GrassField polls editorTunables().revision() (150ms) and re-rolls when a knob changes. For COLOUR the user asked to reuse the existing picker — added a custom GrassRig in editors/workbench/settings/rigs.tsx (dispatched for system 'grass') that renders two ColorWheel pickers (root low / root high) reading/writing the rootLo/rootHi rgb tunables via store.set, so picking a colour persists + recolours the lawn live; height/density stay as the panel sliders. For /compiled parity, bakeGameFile now folds the persisted tuning (editorTunables().applyOverrides(editorChannel(tuningStream).state().overrides)) before building the map — same store root (cart/hmsc-int/data) and same fold index.tsx does on boot — so the no-V8 world honours tuned values. Verified: hmsc-int rebuilt + self-shot PASS, rjit game shot PASS (bake + applyOverrides path runs, 19344 blades). Not committed (shared files).
